owner_authorization: Proceed with Phase20K.1 locally; additional CPU/RAM/disk/time and reproducible build-cache cleanup authorized; preserve old evidence

new_policy: Those are historical limits only, not limits for new20K.1 campaigns. Create new exclusive receipts; never reset or rewrite old receipts/results.
resize_rule: Resize dedicated VM only when measured scheduling/memory/disk justify it and host pressure/swap activity remain safe; original k VM is protected
sustained_swap_stop: Three consecutive samples with new host swap-out rate above16MiB/s; retain historical swap occupancy separately
execution_scope: Local image builds and bounded project-owned application/integration/recovery fixtures only; no private source replay/dashboard/Phase21
protected: Original Lima k VM; accepted topics/volumes/archives/checkpoints/results and earlier namespaces; previous failed image manifest and logs
cache_cleanup: Only reproducible BuildKit/temporary source caches in dedicated VM; no data/PVC/image evidence deletion
external_server: Investigate only if local inadequacy measured; no paid provisioning/private-data upload/credential transfer without separate authorization
quota: Check actual current session quota at safe boundaries; stop near exhaustion and resume after verified refill
